sentences.text: 1 (Judgment of the Court was pronounced by HULUVADI G.RAMESH, J.)
The Writ Appeal is directed against the order dated 20.02.2018 made in WMP.No.27464 of 2017 in W.P.No.19831 of 2017 by a learned Single Judge.
2. The said Miscellaneous Petition has been filed by the respondent in W.P.No.19831/2017 to vacate the interim order of stay granted on 02.08.2017 in that writ petition.
The learned Single Judge by his order dated 20.02.2018, has dismissed the said petition.
Aggrieved over the same, the present Writ Appeal has been filed.
3. Heard the submissions made on either side.
We have also perused the materials available on record carefully.

4. At the outset, it appears that though the 1st respondent herein was originally working in the Chennai Municipal Corporation, on implementation of the Food Safety and Standards Act, he was asked to work as a Food and Safety Officer under the aforesaid Act.

It further appears that in the meanwhile, the Government having created a new Department for implementation of the said act,
decided to appoint the Food Safety Officials by deployment from the Senior Sanitary Inspector/Food Inspector working in the Municipal Corporation as well as the Food Inspector under the Health Department.
The 1st respondent, being the senior, he has been so deployed along with others.
The same was opposed by the appellant herein, but the 1st respondent has obtained a stay from a learned Single Judge of this Court by filing W.P.No.19831/2017 in respect of the said deployment.
Therefore, the appellant, namely, the Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department has filed a Vacate Stay Petition before the learned Single Judge.

entities.text: Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The same was dismissed by order dated 20.02.2018 observing as under:
''...such deployment appears to be permanent as the department having created,
wants to fill up the post with Senior Food Inspector working under the repealed Food Adulteration Act.

In such premises, prima facie it cannot be accepted that he having his lien with Chennai Municipal Corporation and not an employee of the newly created Department i.e. Respondent No.1 to the Writ Petition, his original employer i.e. Respondent No.1 to the Writ Petition.
His original employer i.e. Greater Chennai Municipal Corporation/Respondent No.3 also support such stand with the submission that no post exist to accommodate the writ petitioner.

In such circumstances, the prayer made to vacate the order of staying the operation of the impugned order, in the writ miscellaneous petition filed by the respondent no.1,
appears to be devoid of merit and accordingly dismissed.''

Aggrieved over the same,
the present Writ Appeal has been preferred.
5. A perusal of the above interim order would reveal that finality being reached in this matter.

Therefore, we are of the view that by providing an opportunity, the writ petition may be finally heard and disposed of by the learned Single Judge, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
Till such time, the parties are directed to maintain status quo as on today.
